description: Source code for the DictionaryManager class in the tinygettext library, handling translation dictionaries, language selection, and filesystem interactions.

classes.name: DictionaryManager
classes.description: Manages translation dictionaries, language settings, and filesystem interactions within tinygettext.

methods.name: DictionaryManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DictionaryManager with charset and filesystem.

methods.name: clear_cache
methods.description: Clears cached dictionaries and resets current dictionary.

methods.name: get_dictionary
methods.description: Returns the current dictionary, loading based on current language if necessary.

methods.name: get_dictionary (overload)
methods.description: Loads and returns the dictionary for a specified language.

methods.name: get_languages
methods.description: Returns a set of available languages based on .po files in search paths.

methods.name: set_language
methods.description: Sets the current language and resets the current dictionary.

methods.name: set_charset
methods.description: Sets the charset and clears cache.

methods.name: set_use_fuzzy
methods.description: Enables or disables fuzzy matching and clears cache.

methods.name: get_use_fuzzy
methods.description: Returns whether fuzzy matching is enabled.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Adds a directory to the search path, with optional precedence.

methods.name: remove_directory
methods.description: Removes a directory from the search path.

methods.name: set_filesystem
methods.description: Sets a new filesystem object for dictionary loading.
